name: kq-app-annotate-played-at
description: Call tool 'ciq_execute' with arguments: id: "<this query's id>", input_params: {track_external_id: (required) external_id of the Track, venue_external_id: (required) external_id of the Venue, first_played_at: (required) timestamp to set}. Auth: X-IK-ClientKey only (_Application subject), no Bearer token, $_appId is auto-filled. Returns: the updated PLAYED_AT relationship (verified, first_played_at).
